header.titleZh: 我在埃斯孔迪多港的怪異之旅（故事時間）——適合中級聽眾的慢英語！
header.titleEn: My WEIRD trip in Puerto Escondido (storytime)— SLOW ENGLISH  for Intermediate Listeners!

sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk about my trip to Puerto Escondido so far.
sentences.tc: 今天我想談談迄今為止我的埃斯孔迪多港之旅。

sentences.en: I arrived in Puerto Gondido a few weeks ago. I went to the beach for lots of sunsets. Sunsets at the beach are just something else.
sentences.tc: 我幾週前抵達貢迪多港。我去海灘看了很多日落。海灘上的日落只是另一回事。

sentences.en: They are all so special to me. I went to a beautiful beach called Garisalo where the view was spectacular. I ate dried fruit at the beach.
sentences.tc: 他們對我來說都很特別。我去了一個叫加里薩洛的美麗海灘，那裡的景色非常壯觀。我在海邊吃了乾果。

sentences.en: I love dried fruit, especially if I'm eating it at the beach.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡乾果，尤其是在海灘上吃的時候。

sentences.en: I also went to other beaches where the waves were massive. It's very dangerous to try and swim in those waves.
sentences.tc: 我還去了其他海浪很大的海灘。嘗試在這些波浪中游泳是非常危險的。

sentences.en: I got fish tacos at a place called Pepis Tacos.
sentences.tc: 我在一個叫 Pepis Tacos 的地方買了魚炸玉米餅。

sentences.en: They were amazing. The best fish tacos I've ever tried.
sentences.tc: 他們太棒了。我吃過的最好的魚炸玉米餅。

sentences.en: The petals just laying on the ground.
sentences.tc: 花瓣剛剛落在地上。

sentences.en: Then I also went to a skating competition where I saw really good skaters compete for a prize for a reward.
sentences.tc: 然後我還去參加了一場滑冰比賽，在那裡我看到了非常優秀的滑冰選手為了獎勵而競爭。

sentences.en: I have been volunteering here at a hostel here on the beach.
sentences.tc: 我一直在海灘上的一家旅館當志工。
